Houthis Attack Ship in Bab al-Mandeb, Six Killed

Houthi rebels attacked a cargo ship in the Bab al-Mandeb strait, resulting in the deaths of six individuals. The Yemen government reported the attack, stating that three of the deceased were Pakistani nationals. A second strike reportedly occurred during rescue operations. The vessel targeted was identified as the Egyptian cargo ship 'Tihama'. The attack is described as the "deadliest" Red Sea attack by the Houthis.
